analysis: {'Project A': {'Clarity of Value Proposition': '• Relatively clear – focuses on practical AI skills for individuals and teams. The ‘AI Mentor’ and ‘Agent Playground’ are understandable concepts.', 'Market Size and Demand': '• Good – the demand for AI skills is demonstrably high and growing, targeting both individual learners and enterprise adoption.', 'Feasibility and Development Plan': '• Moderate – the four-phase timeline feels somewhat vague. ‘Prototypes’ are a good start, but the specifics of the AI Mentor and Agent Playground are lacking.', 'Revenue Model and Sustainability': '• Potentially strong – micro-courses and enterprise programs offer diverse revenue streams. Creator-driven model is appealing.', 'Differentiation': '• Moderate – blending live news, micro-lessons, and a personalized mentor is a decent approach, but the AI landscape is crowded.', 'Impact and Evidence Plan': '• Weak – The ‘global challenge’ is a nice idea, but lacks concrete evidence of impact or a clear measurement plan.  Reliance on ‘human review’ for AI content raises concerns.', 'Risk Awareness and Mitigation': '• Adequate – Identifies key risks (AI integration, UX, accessibility) and proposes reasonable mitigations. Monthly updates are a positive.', 'Pros': '• Well-defined target users and use cases. Clear articulation of a creator-driven ecosystem.  Mention of enterprise programs.', 'Cons': '• Roadmap is vague. ‘Prototypes’ lack detail.  Reliance on AI for content creation needs careful scrutiny. Impact measurement is weak.'}, 'Project B': {'Clarity of Value Proposition': '• Clear – the core concept of scanning tools and generating custom outlines is easily understood. The problem it solves is tangible.', 'Market Size and Demand': '• Good – addresses a common need for custom tool storage, appealing to makers, shops, and professionals.', 'Feasibility and Development Plan': '• Moderate – The ‘new app’ roadmap is ambitious, and the acknowledgement of potential staffing challenges raises concerns.  ‘Shipping a focused core’ is a reasonable strategy.', 'Revenue Model and Sustainability': '• Moderate – In-app ordering and potential licensing of tool shapes offer revenue opportunities, but success depends on user adoption.', 'Differentiation': "• Moderate – The combination of phone scanning, desktop editing, and in-app ordering is a useful combination, but the market isn't entirely untapped.", 'Impact and Evidence Plan': '• Weak – The campaign lacks concrete evidence of user needs or market validation.  ‘Public library’ is a good start, but needs more detail.', 'Risk Awareness and Mitigation': '• Adequate – Addresses scanning accuracy, file compatibility, and platform stability.  Shipping a core is a good risk mitigation.', 'Pros': '• Working concept with both phone and desktop components.  Clear problem statement and solution.  Focus on a core feature set.', 'Cons': '• Roadmap is dependent on staffing.  Lack of user validation.  Reliance on AI-generated code raises potential concerns about quality and bias.'}}
